items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: "Sam Price is dancing with the Alphonso Trent Band,"

ctx.x: Yeah, Alphonso was the piano player. He liked me and he used to...then I used to start bugging him to show me things. Whenever we would go...say if we were playing the Adolphus Hotel, we may arrive at the place an hour before, you understand, and he may be practicing like, learning a new song or something. I could sit in on the rehearsals. I began to hear, you know, "That's a B-flat...tune your horn," and that business. So I had an opportunity to learn something about music and about the piano and about how to…

"Sam Price has learned...man, he's playing the piano," and this, that and the other. You know, I could play the Charleston, you know I could play 'My Isle of Golden Dreams' the "Charleston," or whatever there it was, I'd play these things. So finally this man came to me and said, he wanted me to come to Athens, Texas, to play for a dance. He'd pay me five dollars a night for a Saturday and Sunday. And I could...Christmas was on Monday, so I had an opportunity to go and play for him and come back and be home in…
